d: Lead at Scale. Deliver at Speed. Build Operational Excellence.
At Boutiqaat, delivering exceptional customer experiences requires more than great products. It takes an operation built for speed, precision, and continuous improvement.

As one of the Middle East's leading e-commerce platforms, we're looking for an experienced Senior Operations Manager to lead and optimize our warehouse, fulfillment, inventory, and domestic distribution operations. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for someone who understands the complexity of large-scale operations, thrives in high-volume environments, and knows how to turn operational strategy into measurable results.

You'll oversee operational performance across our Central Warehouse and regional fulfillment hubs, ensuring that people, processes, technology, and resources work together to deliver exceptional service.

Working closely with senior leadership, you'll translate business priorities into effective operational plans, lead multifunctional teams, and drive improvements in productivity, cost, capacity, quality, and customer experience.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or master's degree is preferred.
Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in warehouse, supply chain, logistics, e-commerce, retail, or operations management.
At least 6 years of managerial or senior operational leadership experience , managing large, multifunctional teams.
Proven experience overseeing complex warehouse and fulfillment operations across inbound, outbound, inventory, B2B, B2C, and logistics.
Strong understanding of high-volume fulfillment, express delivery, same-day operations, and service-level management.
Experience managing multi-site operations, third-party logistics providers, or regional fulfillment networks is an advantage.
Strong capabilities in capacity planning, workforce optimization, cost management, and operational performance improvement.
Proficiency in ERP, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and logistics management systems.
Advanced Excel, reporting, and analytical skills. Experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.
Strong leadership, strategic execution, change management, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
At Boutiqaat, operational excellence directly shapes the customer experience.
You'll have the opportunity to lead complex, high-volume operations, strengthen the capabilities of our teams, and influence how we scale our fulfillment infrastructure.
This is a role for a leader who wants to do more than manage daily operations.
It's an opportunity to build stronger systems, develop future leaders, and create an operation ready for what's next.
Ready to Lead the Next Level of Operations?
If you're a results-driven operational leader with the experience to manage complexity, the vision to improve performance, and the ability to inspire large teams, we'd like to hear from you.
